title: As he enters his third year, Tom Brady reiterates his 10-year commitment to Fox

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: As he enters his third year, Tom Brady reiterates his 10-year commitment to Fox
sources.description: As Tom Brady begins his third season as the No. 1 NFL analyst at Fox and his second full season as a minority owner (but majority influence) over the Raiders, he has no plan to step away from the effort to keep two very large plates spinning.
